coordinates: TOP-LEFT origin; normalized bbox fractions of complete canvas. x right, y down. Rotation in Matplotlib counterclockwise; 90 corresponds to PPT 270.
placement_rule: PPT bbox=(imageX+x*imageW,imageY+y*imageH,w*imageW,h*imageH). Source font pt multiplied by (image width pt /72)/14. For 90-degree text swap unrotated box width/height around its center.
note: All visible Text removed; atomic geometry, markers, cell edges and legend handles unchanged. No tight crop.
